verdict.rationale: Outlook documents Inbox rules that apps can set up to handle incoming messages automatically, such as forwarding specific messages, so event-triggered rules exist natively. The evidence only covers the incoming-message event and thinly describes conditions and actions. Change notifications are a developer building block, not user-defined rules, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: rule triggers beyond incoming mail (e.g. calendar or other events), documented range of rule conditions and actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Use Inbox rules to automate actions such as forwarding specific incoming messages
Apps can set up [Inbox rules](/en-us/graph/api/resources/messagerule) to promptly handle incoming messages and reduce email clutter.
